kaikki_vikisozluk.e: فِرْقَة الْمَطَافِئ • (firqat al-maṭāfiʔ) f (plural فِرَق الْمَطَافِئ (firaq al-maṭāfiʔ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, "company of the fire extinguishers", from فِرْقَة (firqa, “company, band, group, unit, division, etc.”) + الْمَطَافِئ (al-maṭāfiʔ, “the fire extinguishers”).
s: فِرْقَة (firqa, “company, band, group, unit, division, etc.”) + الْمَطَافِئ (al-maṭāfiʔ, “the fire extinguishers”)
